verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general built-in AI assistant inside Dover that users can hand tasks to. What it does show is single-purpose AI features: applicant scoring, AI-suggested interview questions, and an AI Notetaker that fills feedback forms. It also documents an MCP server, but that lets external AI clients act on Dover rather than providing an in-product assistant. These are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
